verdict.rationale: Martin documents first-party calendar and inbox integrations that, once connected, let it read events and emails and act on them, including forwarding emails so events are added to the calendar. The evidence pack never mentions any cloud drive or file-storage connector, so one of the three sources in the story is unsupported. missing for 10: cloud drive connector, explicit evidence of searching across connected email/calendar content to ground answers, independent hands-on corroboration of the integrations.
